body.statement: Conditional on \((M,\Omega)\), fixed \(q\), uniform sub-Gaussian moments, row-law factorization, conditional within-row block dependence, variance nondegeneracy, and the derived score-diffuseness bounds imply \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P(L/s\le z\mid M,\Omega)-\Phi(z)|\to0\).
body.justification: A uniform dependency-graph Lyapunov argument derives the Gaussian limit from primitive dependence, moments, and diffuse weights.
body.gap: Existing serial factor central limit theorems do not cover this three-block influence array under deterministic causal-block masking.
body.consumer: The Wald theorem uses this derived score limit instead of assuming asymptotic normality.

obligation.what_is_open: The conditional uniform Lyapunov bound under the frozen moment assumptions.
obligation.obstruction: An unconditional sub-Gaussian norm bound permits conditional third moments given the signal to be arbitrarily large on rare signal events, so it does not establish the almost-sure conditional uniform approximation stated in the target.
obligation.attempted: Derived coordinate diffuseness and reduced the bounded-degree dependency-graph error to a conditional third-moment sum. Proposed the standard conditional sub-Gaussian strengthening rather than assuming the Gaussian limit.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved score-diffuseness bounds reduce the conditional central limit theorem to conditional moment control.  Under the proposed conditional sub-Gaussian assumption, the variables \(X_{js}=w_{js}\epsilon_{js}/s\), conditional on \((M,\Omega)\), have a dependency graph of maximum degree at most \(2q\), satisfy
\[
 \sum_{j,s}\mathbb E(|X_{js}|^3\mid M,\Omega)
 \le C_qK^3\frac{\max_{j,s}|w_{js}|}{s}\frac{\sum_{j,s}w_{js}^2}{s^2}=o(1),
\]
and have total conditional variance one by the definition of \(s^2\).  The usual characteristic-function proof for bounded-degree dependency graphs then yields the stated uniform Gaussian limit.  The existing unconditional Orlicz bound alone does not make the displayed conditional Lyapunov quantity uniformly bounded almost surely.
